## Master Swim Program

*2,500m Daily Routine & Efficiency Guide* - every session is 2,500m / 100 lengths in a 25m pool, about 90 minutes with rests. The routine is fixed to the weekday.

### Weekly Rotation

| Day | Routine | Primary Training Objective |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Monday | The Interleaved Circuit | Active chest opening & shoulder alignment; prevents rotator impingement. |
| Tuesday | The Gear Shift / Pace Set | Aerobic threshold conditioning & speed control via 10x100m intervals. |
| Wednesday | The Descending Pyramid Set | Mental engagement & progressive block pacing (700m down to 300m). |
| Thursday | The Interleaved Circuit | Mid-week active joint recovery & external rotation balancing. |
| Friday | The Gear Shift / Pace Set | Distance-per-stroke maintenance under controlled aerobic fatigue. |
| Saturday | Technique & Distance Cruise | Sustained endurance & stroke count tracking across 1,500m Free block. |
| Sunday | The Descending Pyramid Set | Volume endurance with shrinking block structure. |

### The Interleaved Circuit (Monday, Thursday)

*Target: Shoulder rotator balance & active posture reset*

5 rounds of this 500m block:

- **Freestyle (300m / 12 lengths):** Steady cruise pace. 2-stroke breathing, alternating side per length.
    - *Rest: 10 seconds at wall.*
- **Breaststroke (100m / 4 lengths):** Smooth glide pace; active upper-body rest.
    - *Rest: 10 seconds at wall.*
- **Backstroke (100m / 4 lengths):** Active chest opener to stretch pectorals and reset shoulders.
    - *Rest: 30 seconds at wall before starting next round.*

### The Gear Shift / Pace Set (Tuesday, Friday)

*Target: Aerobic conditioning & tempo variation*

- **Block 1 - Warm-Up (500m / 20 lengths):** 300m Free + 10s rest + 200m Back.
    - *Rest: 45s at wall.*
- **Block 2 - Main Pace Interval (1,000m / 40 lengths):** 10 x 100m Freestyle (4 lengths each).
    - Rest: exactly 15 seconds at wall after each 100m.
    - Pacing: sets 1, 3, 5, 7, 9 = Cruise pace. Sets 2, 4, 6, 8, 10 = Brisk pace (effort 7-8/10).
    - *Rest: 60 seconds at wall after set 10.*
- **Block 3 - Active Recovery (500m / 20 lengths):** 500m Breaststroke continuous glide.
    - *Rest: 30s at wall.*
- **Block 4 - Cool-Down (500m / 20 lengths):** 500m Backstroke continuous relaxed pace.

### The Descending Pyramid Set (Wednesday, Sunday)

*Target: Progressive block reduction & pacing*

- **Block 1 (700m / 28 lengths):** 400m Free, 10s rest, 150m Breast, 10s rest, 150m Back.
    - *Rest: 30s at wall.*
- **Block 2 (600m / 24 lengths):** 300m Free, 10s rest, 150m Breast, 10s rest, 150m Back.
    - *Rest: 30s at wall.*
- **Block 3 (500m / 20 lengths):** 200m Free, 10s rest, 150m Breast, 10s rest, 150m Back.
    - *Rest: 25s at wall.*
- **Block 4 (400m / 16 lengths):** 100m Free, 10s rest, 150m Breast, 10s rest, 150m Back.
    - *Rest: 20s at wall.*
- **Block 5 - Cool-Down (300m / 12 lengths):** 100m Free, 100m Breast, 100m Back continuous.

### Technique & Distance Cruise (Saturday)

*Target: Sustained aerobic efficiency & stroke tracking*

- **Block 1 - Long Freestyle Block (1,500m / 60 lengths):** Continuous swim at steady cruise pace. Count strokes on length 10, length 30 and length 50 to verify stroke length consistency.
    - *Rest: 60s at wall.*
- **Block 2 - Breaststroke Block (500m / 20 lengths):** Continuous swim focusing on maximum kick propulsion and glide distance per stroke.
    - *Rest: 30s at wall.*
- **Block 3 - Backstroke Cool-Down (500m / 20 lengths):** Continuous relaxed backstroke to open chest and decompress shoulders.

### Emergency Backup Routine: Modular Express Set

For days when work or life limits pool time. A flexible 400m main block scales to the time available.

- **Warm-Up (200m / 8 lengths):** 100m Free + 100m Back continuous.
    - *Rest: 30s.*
- **Modular Main Block (400m / 16 lengths):** 4 x 100m (50m Freestyle Brisk Pace + 50m Breast or Back Recovery Pace). Take 15 seconds rest at wall after each 100m.
- **Cool-Down (200m / 8 lengths):** 100m Breast + 100m Back continuous.

**Time options** (estimated from the real pace, 2,500m in 90 minutes, rests included):

1. **About 30 min - 800m / 32 lengths:** Warm-Up + 1 Main Block + Cool-Down.
2. **About 45 min - 1,200m / 48 lengths:** Warm-Up + 2 Main Blocks + Cool-Down.
3. **About 60 min - 1,600m / 64 lengths:** Warm-Up + 3 Main Blocks + Cool-Down.

*You are free to swap Breaststroke and Backstroke during recovery lengths whenever your shoulders or knees need a change.*

### Breathing Protocol & Oxygenation

- **2-Stroke Alternating Pattern:** Breathe every 2 strokes, alternating your breathing side every 25m length (e.g., breathe right going down, breathe left coming back).
- **Neuromuscular & Joint Balance:** Alternating sides per length prevents asymmetrical neck/shoulder strain while maintaining distance-per-stroke symmetry.
- **Why Not 3-Stroke:** Breathing every 2 strokes maintains steady, high oxygen saturation. Bilateral 3-stroke breathing reduces breathing frequency by 33%, causing air starvation during longer blocks. Stick strictly to 2-stroke alternating.

### Open Turn Technique (Floor-Free Pivot)

Never step or stand on the pool floor during turns. Stepping causes sudden joint impact on ankles and knees, breaks forward momentum, and places torsional stress on the lower back.

| Step | Phase | Action & Biomechanical Cue |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | The Touch | Touch wall with one hand (Free/Back) or both hands (Breast) at surface level without grabbing edge. |
| 2 | Tuck & Pivot | Allow momentum to bring hips toward wall. Tuck knees tightly to chest underwater (no floor contact). |
| 3 | The Plant | Rotate body sideways and plant both feet flat against wall, 30-50cm below surface. |
| 4 | Streamline Push | Push off horizontally in full streamline position (arms locked overhead, hands stacked) before rotating into stroke. |

### Missed Session Policy

- **Immediate Resumption:** If you miss one or several days, resume immediately on the workout scheduled for the day you return. Never attempt to make up missed volume or stack workouts.
- **Extended Absences (>5 Days):** Keep intensity at 70% effort for the first two sessions upon return to allow shoulder internal/external rotators to re-acclimate safely.

## Locker-Room Transition Fuel (08:30)

**Recipe:** 200-250ml (0.20-0.25 L) Leche Desnatada Omega-3 + 1 tbsp Miel Pura + a pinch of salt.

**Why:** Restores blood glucose and halts muscle breakdown immediately following 90 minutes of fasted swimming. Small enough to drink in the five minutes it takes to change, so there is no stomach sloshing or heaviness under a loaded bar minutes later.
